ES: negative mean of worst ceil(alpha*N) returns; stable date order breaks ties
VaR: negative linear return quantile at .05/.01; positive means loss
bootstrap: NOT_RUN_OPTIONAL; paired48 monthly/four annual deltas; inference deferred Stage6
channel_rubric: No composite. Full-period + all annual nonnegative = SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY; conflicting = MIXED; nonpositive with no consistent gain = NO_EVIDENCE; absent = NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
drawdown: initial NAV included, recovery>=prior peak, underwater counts dd<0 observations
normalization: both constant control/S2C realized mean RTH gross and realized annual vol ratios
paired_tails: control worst/best ceil(.05*N) and worst ceil(.01*N), same dates for S2C
scaled_proxy: NONEXECUTABLE; multiply already-net daily returns; no orders or new fees
